title: Network Realignment Complexes over General Graphs
summary: Network realignment complexes were introduced by Kozlov. We generalise their definition to arbitrary connected base graphs. For a connected graph $G$, we characterise the connected components of the associated network realignment complex $X_G$ and show that $X_G$ admits an $\operatorname{Aut}(G)$-equivariant strong deformation retraction onto the disjoint union of a complete graph and a discrete $\operatorname{Aut}(G)$-space.
